about: Account words (plans/accounts.md 3.2, 4.1, 4.3, 5, D13), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps; each platform's reader test checks every key (phase 2). Announcements (SyncReport.announcements) take one key each: kind device is announceDevice, or announceDeviceUnnamed when name is null; passkey is announcePasskey; kit is announceKit; removed is announceLeft when by equals member (announceLeftUnnamed without a name), else announceRemovedPasskey when passkey, else announceRemovedKit when kit, else announceRemoved (announceRemovedUnnamed without a name); dropped is announceDropped. {name} is the announcement's name. {device} is the name of the member by, from syncDevices: announceUnnamedDevice when that member has no name, announceGoneDevice when it is no longer a member. announcePasskey carries announceNotYou. Only the owner profile shows and acknowledges device, passkey and dropped (the core answers notOwner otherwise). {provider} is Apple, Google or Facebook; {providerAccount} is from providerAccount. {date} is the medium date in the device's locale. An actions list is the buttons in order, the first the primary. The default path never shows the words Kit (alone), PRF, roster, ticket or sync server.
announceKit: A recovery kit was made on {device}.
announceRemoved: {name} was removed from your account on {device}.
announceRemovedUnnamed: A device was removed from your account on {device}.

announceRemovedKit: A recovery kit was removed from your account on {device}.
announceLeftUnnamed: A device signed out of your account.
announceDropped: Older changes were not kept. Check Devices.
announceGoneDevice: a device no longer in your account
accountGone: Your Marquee account was deleted. Your library stays on this device.

noSecondWayIn: Without a passkey or recovery kit, losing this phone means losing what it syncs.
removeLibraryAsk: Remove your profiles and library from this device?
unreachable: Marquee can't reach its sync service right now.
kitUnknownPasskey: Your passkey didn't open your account on this device. Scan this code with a device that's signed in.
